## 1. Technical Architecture & Engine Specs

### ERAVEX (Procedural WebGPU Engine)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/apoorv-xs/ERAVEX
- **Live Deployment:** https://eravex.vercel.app
- **Scale:** 21,000+ lines of procedural TypeScript, 0 external 3D assets, 0 external audio files.
- **Visual Synthesis:** Pure procedural generation using Three.js (v0.184), React Three Fiber (v9.6), and TSL (Three.js Shading Language) on WebGPU with WebGL fallback.
- **Audio Synthesis:** Custom 8-voice procedural synthesizer leveraging the browser Web Audio API (`useSoundSynth`, 1,041 lines) generating real-time waveforms without `.mp3` or `.wav` dependencies.
- **Industry Validation:** Followed, liked, and recognized by the official Three.js core engineering team.

### Level Devil 2.5D Spatial Portfolio Engine
- **Live Deployment:** https://apoorv.qzz.io/
- **Hybrid Kinematics:** Merges 2D swept-collision physics (Kaboom.js engine, 3-sub-step vertical integration, gravity 1600 px/s²) with a real-time cel-shaded 3D Three.js companion (BB-8 droid).
- **Coordinate Projection:** 3D-to-DOM projection bridge (`to3DX()`, `to3DY()`, `to3DVec()`) ensuring sub-pixel alignment across 5 vertical strata.
- **Autonomous Companion Brain:** Non-autoregressive reactive state machine (`system1_brain.js`) executing 60 FPS telemetry loops with real-time pathfinding and contextual thought bubbles.
- **Quality Invariants:** 934 automated tests (Vitest + Playwright E2E), strict DPR clamping (`Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2)`), and complete GPU memory lifecycle management (`dispose()` on geometries, materials, render targets).
